The Court Made The Following:
 Order
1. This petition is filed challenging the registration of first information report (FIR) against the petitioner, which has also culminated in the filing of the charge sheet.
2. The petitioner is the brother-in-law of the complainant who was married to the brother of the petitioner on 7th December, 2014.
3. The sister-in-law of the petitioner lodged a complaint on 31st July, 2017 alleging that her husband assaulted her and was consistantly making demands for dowry.

4. It may be pertinent to state here that in the entire complaint, there is no direct allegation made against the petitioner and the only assertion is that the family NC: 2024:KHC:20613 members of her husband were harassing her.
The police have investigated the case and filed the chargesheet, in which also there is no allegation made against the petitioner herein and the entire thrust of the charge is against the husband.
5. It is not in dispute that the husband had also initiated proceedings for divorce in M.C.No.384 of 2016 and the marriage has also been dissolved by grant of a decree of divorce.
It is stated that an appeal as against the said decree of divorce is also pending consideration.

6. In the light of the fact that there is absolutely no allegation made specifically against the brother-in-law i.e., the petitioner herein, there is no justification for initiation of proceedings against the petitioner for the offences punishable under Sections 498(A), 504, 323, 506 read with Sections 34 the IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
